tools.name: search_deck
tools.description: Search one deck. `query` substring-matches the term, its reading/pronunciation, its English meanings, and its category, so "bone" finds entries glossed as bone and "ㄱ" finds that jamo. Narrow with `category` (exact, from list_decks) or `difficulty` (1-5; for the kanji deck this is the school grade).

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: One deck entry in full, matched on the exact term (the kanji, hanzi, jamo, or word itself). Case-insensitive. tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: What K2 is, which apps it runs, what this server does and does not expose, and every machine-readable surface. Also returns the full capability map — every tool, prompt, and resource — so a client with a stale or tools-only roster can still see the whole surface.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_cube_algorithms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
